correctness.rationale: The within-role minus-population penalty excludes repeated role members from every individually rational coalition; the positive welfare case is therefore an exact packing by cross-role edges and triangles. The maximum-role capacity gives T <= n-2a; the explicit t=b+c-a triplets, a-c AB pairs and a-b AC pairs attain it, and equality characterizes all maximizers. Counting bijections produces a!b!c!/(t!(a-c)!(a-b)!). Verified by two independently designed exact enumeration modes: 715 clique-partition profiles and 224935 unrestricted game partitions over 161 small profiles. Finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General hardness and approximation do not imply an exact optimal value or multiplicity on every complete tripartite instance. Utilitarian welfare is a different aggregate, and can select singleton-containing configurations with Nash product zero.

originality.rationale: The May 2026 Nash-hedonic paper supplies the IR/clique framework, general hardness and approximate algorithms, not exact tripartite welfare and labeled optimizer enumeration. The 2025 multipartite network paper optimizes utilitarian rather than Nash welfare; its result cannot imply the present all-positive equilibrium welfare. The closest OEIS table counts maximal graph matchings, not partitions into mixed edges and triangles. Indexed literature and mathematical records examined gave no equivalence, with residual priority risks acknowledged.

value.rationale: A natural structured family of the source hedonic-game model has a complete optimum and equality characterization in terms of the largest role class. The formula also exactly enumerates all labeled optimal coalition structures, providing information absent from the general hardness, approximation, and utilitarian multipartite results. Sharp majority threshold and exact multiplicity are mathematically motivated invariants; the result is not a routine table lookup.
